signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 3 reviews (16.7% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: Most of my support tickets are not resolved, some are not answered.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 18 reviews average 4.39/5 vs 4.39/5 all-time (+0). 11% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $59 tier lacks 7 of 11 features in the $149 tier.

signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to Prismical with future Premium Plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Prismical
- All future Premium Plan updates
- If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms reserve the right to modify the app or charge for services at any time for any reason, which materially limits the guaranteed lifetime access despite the deal being sold as lifetime.

exhibits.quote: they reserve the right to modify the Application or charge for their services at any time and for any reason.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves unilateral right to change or charge for the app, undermining guaranteed lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: It looks very promising (snagged the lifetime deal!) to replace them all.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase was sold as a lifetime deal.

exhibits.quote: Start free, forever. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited transcription and your whole team.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms a Premium plan exists with unlimited transcription that the lifetime deal maps to.

trials.claimQuote: Turn any speech into structured notes with unlimited local transcription, speaker ID, and MCP integrations
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms live local-model transcription with speaker identification and MCP integration; the single report of a missing recording segment is a reliability issue, not a limit on unlimited transcription.

exhibits.quote: During a roughly 25-minute lag, I stopped the recording—and the final 25 minutes were completely missing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports large portion of recording missing, undermining claim of unlimited reliable transcription.

exhibits.quote: Live speech-to-text with speaker identification. Powered by local models (Whisper) or cloud providers (OpenAI, Deepgram) — your choice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms local-model transcription with speaker identification as promised.

exhibits.quote: Prismical includes an MCP server that lets AI assistants read and write your notes.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms MCP integration for AI assistants is included.

trials.claim: Unlimited Local model transcription on Tier 1
trials.claimQuote:
Standard (60 minutes) Recording length
- Unlimited Local model transcription
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms on-device Whisper transcription, and the 60-minute limit cited is a per-recording length limit disclosed alongside the deal, not a cap on total local transcription.

exhibits.quote: Skip Tier 1 - no floating widget, no Ask AI, only 60-minute recordings.
exhibits.argument: Tier 1 recordings are capped at 60 minutes, so local transcription cannot be truly unlimited.

exhibits.quote: 60 min recording cap on Tier 1 gets restrictive
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms 60-minute cap restricts use, contradicting unlimited transcription on Tier 1.

exhibits.quote: 60 min recording cap on Tier 1 gets restrictive
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Tier 1 has a 60-minute recording limit.

exhibits.quote: Transcribe on-device using Whisper. No audio leaves your machine unless you choose otherwise.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms on-device local transcription using Whisper is available.
